title: End Minus Start
blurb: Marcus's first day on the mountain. A change is always end minus start, on the shaft lift and on the cable line: change in level over change in posts, from a graph, from a logbook with uneven stops, and from just two points.
note: Captions stay on. This film runs 7:52: stop when Chip's news call ends (3:48) for questions on the lift and the three spans, then play the rest. Also pause twice and ask what Doug will write on the report: first after Marcus says "Plus six!" at the shaft lift (0:55), then after "Dial it to six!" at the logbook (4:44). At the end, say the helmet line together: end minus start, level change over post change.
